== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Death Star: Trench (Japanese)|Death Star: Trench]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/sputman1021/imagegallery/47850 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 159081597.

Crop rectangle <code>(133, 604, 1296, 2230)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c123cc5a9dea7f06e7e3a5422135894d2ff0a762fae65dddb9d2cc4fb9a17811</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
